headline: ‘AI rebounding’: Nearly 20% of U.S. workers replaced by AI are being asked back, now demanding higher pay, job security and AI transparency
claim: Employers replaced workers with AI, then asked some of them back, with regret over AI-linked cuts.
notes: published 2026-11-09 (page date read via WebFetch). Reports the SHL survey fielded by Propeller Insights in June and July 2026 (US and UK). SHL is a commercial talent-assessment firm (interested party). The 19.1% figure is workers' own accounts of being invited back, not verified rehiring. Same survey as the CNBC, Breitbart and People Matters rows.

headline: How data center demand is reshaping electricity costs across the US
claim: Data center demand is raising electricity costs for businesses and households, depending on region.
notes: published 2026-11-16 (page date read via WebFetch). Stacker explainer, syndicated; written with Lucas Winter for Shipley Energy (a commercial energy firm, interested party). Effect described as regional and conditional; cites Grid Strategies, LBNL, EIA, Dallas Fed, PJM and state regulator filings. Notes that forecasts may overstate demand.
